entities.summary: Germany was set to be represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2020 with the song "Violent Thing", written by Borislav Milanov, Peter St. James, Dag Lundberg, Jimmy Thorén, and Connor Martin, and performed by Ben Dolic. The German participating broadcaster on behalf of ARD, Norddeutscher Rundfunk (NDR), internally selected its entry for the contest. The presentation of "Violent Thing" as the German entry occurred during the show Unser Lied für Rotterdam on 27 February 2020.
